svg.aria-label: Integer schedulers: the machine behind its exits
svg.text: Integer schedulers: the machine behind its exits
Drawn from the Passages room. A micro-op comes in and takes one exit: a wait, or a step on to the next room. Each exit is a state, and each pair of states has one arc.
while a source is not ready
while the MUL buffer is full
until an entry frees in the integer units
Solid arcs rest on measurements or two sources.
Dashed arcs rest on one source or are derived or inferred.
~ enter queue: Into a scheduler queue
◆ wait operand: Wait for a source
~ wait select: Ready, but not the oldest
~ issue partner: Issued by the partner queue's unit
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
